verdict.rationale: Official SDKs are a fair question for a package manager like Homebrew, since it could ship client libraries for its formulae/cask API, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows only the CLI (homebrew-probe-3) and a JSON listing endpoint (homebrew-docs-70); no OpenAPI spec was found (homebrew-probe-2). Raw JSON endpoints are a developer building block, not an official SDK, so there is no evidence of the capability.
